args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, light backpack)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera (with waterproof case if possible)
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations, flight info)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Evening attire (for the Luau on June 16)
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented at Hanauma Bay)
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent
- Medications and first aid supplies
- Phone charger and power bank
- Travel adapter if needed
